info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/wan-25-preview/text-to-image
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/wan-25-preview/text-to-image queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
Generate images from text using WAN 2.5 text-to-image model.

WAN 2.5 text-to-image model features:
- High-quality image generation with various artistic styles
- Support for realistic photography and creative applications
- Resolution: Total pixels between 768×768 and 1440×1440
- Aspect ratio: [1:4, 4:1]
- Up to 4 images per request
- Processing time: 1-2 minutes

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Random seed for reproducibility. If None, a random seed is chosen.

enable_prompt_expansion.title: Enable Prompt Expansion
enable_prompt_expansion.description: Whether to enable prompt rewriting using LLM. Improves results for short prompts but increases processing time.

negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt
examples: low resolution, error, worst quality, low quality, defects
negative_prompt.description: Negative prompt to describe content to avoid. Max 500 characters.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image. Can use preset names like 'square', 'landscape_16_9', etc., or specific dimensions. Total pixels must be between 768×768 and 1440×1440, with aspect ratio between [1:4, 4:1].

prompt.title: Prompt
examples: A lone samurai standing on the edge of a cliff at twilight, overlooking a vast valley shrouded in mist. The sky burns with deep orange and purple hues from the setting sun, casting long, dramatic shadows. The samurai’s silhouette glows against the horizon, with their sword reflecting a glint of fading light. The overall style is hyper-realistic, cinematic, and moody, with dramatic contrast and atmospheric depth.
prompt.description: The prompt for image generation. Supports Chinese and English, max 2000 characters.

num_images.title: Num Images
num_images.description: Number of images to generate. Values from 1 to 4.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.

actual_prompt.title: Actual Prompt
examples: A lone samurai standing on the edge of a cliff at twilight, overlooking a vast valley shrouded in mist. The sky burns with deep orange and purple hues from the setting sun, casting long, dramatic shadows. The samurai’s silhouette glows against the horizon, with their sword reflecting a glint of fading light. The overall style is hyper-realistic, cinematic, and moody, with dramatic contrast and atmospheric depth.
actual_prompt.description: The actual prompt used if prompt rewriting was enabled

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.description: The seeds used for each generated image

width.title: Width
width.description: The width of the generated image.

height.title: Height
height.description: The height of the generated image.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
